purpose: Wave 1E §27-28: a deterministic, ID-keyed manifest of every native visual QA capture the next capable session needs to take before any STRUCTURE_VISUAL_QA_MATRIX.md row can move from PENDING to a real PASS/FAIL. This file is not executed by this session -- see NOTE below and docs/validation/WAVE1_NATIVE_QA_HANDOFF.md for exactly how to run it.
note: Two capture lanes exist because the real native production window and the Dev-only fixture panel are reached differently -- see docs/validation/STRUCTURE_COORDINATE_MODEL.md and demo/ReelPreview.tsx's file header for why they cannot be merged into one lane. lane 'native' drives the REAL production top-arc WebView2 (real Tauri IPC, real OS compositor/DPI, only the fixed 6-provider demo-mode dataset). lane 'fixture' drives the Dev-only demo/ReelPreview.tsx route (a plain-browser render of the real FlowSurface/Reel/Notch components, full synthetic fixture matrix, but NOT proof of native window chrome, DPI scaling, or compositor behavior). A row's passCriteria says which properties it can and cannot prove.

entries.passCriteria: Window docks flush to the right edge (surfaces.rs::anchored_top_arc_position contract); no clipped icon halo (STRUCTURE_ICON_RING_SAFE_BOX.md contract); theme colors match 01-obsidian-orbit tokens; screenshot is from the real WebView2 compositor (evidence.json runtime.dpr present and > 0).

Window docks flush to the left edge; only <=3 reel nodes visible/interactive at once (ReelSurface.test.tsx's own §23 contract, visually confirmed); refreshing dot badge NOT shown (isRefreshing is false outside a real refresh).

Window docks flush to the top edge; DPI test coverage (surfaces.rs logical_to_physical_position tests) matches observed physical pixel position at the machine's actual scale factor from evidence.json runtime.dpr.
Window docks flush into the corner (surfaces.rs corner-dock test coverage, visually confirmed); no overlap with taskbar/other surfaces.

entries.fixtureState: demo-mode + isRefreshing forced true via a short-lived debug hook (see handoff doc for the exact one-line toggle) while cached demo data remains visible
entries.passCriteria: The small dot refreshing badge (FlowSurface.css .flow-surface__refreshing) is visible additively over the cached data -- cached values must NOT blank or flash to a loading skeleton (Wave 1E §18 contract, unit-tested in FlowSurface.test.tsx but never native-verified).
Single provider renders without leftover empty slots or layout collapse.
At most 3 reel nodes are visibly interactive at once (never '70 simultaneous providers'); wheel-cycle still reaches every provider (already unit-tested, native/browser-rendered confirmation only).
Notch-family provider list scrolls/paginates without overflowing the fixed-size native window envelope (Reel/Notch clipping-risk contract in ReelSurface.test.tsx, ported visually).
Long provider name truncates to one line (title attribute carries the full name); footer Pin/Close controls remain visible and clickable (ReelSurface.test.tsx clipping-risk test, ported visually).
Long reset string truncates to one line without pushing footer controls out of frame.
Reset row shows a clear unavailable indicator, never a blank or a fabricated '0s' countdown.
Both usage windows (session + weekly) are reachable and visually distinct, not silently collapsed to one.
Distinct skeleton/loading UI shown, never the same DOM as available/unavailable (QuotalisLoadingStates.test.tsx contract, ported visually).
Cached data visible with an additive small refreshing badge, not a blank/skeleton state.
Clear unavailable messaging, distinct from loading and from a real 0% value.

entries.fixtureState: rtl=1 (layout direction only, no real Arabic text -- see demo/ReelPreview.tsx file header)
entries.passCriteria: Layout mirrors correctly (icon/label/control order, connector/notch orientation if wired); this entry cannot and does not prove real Arabic string rendering -- that needs a live Tauri session, not this route.
Pinned state visually distinct from expanded (persistent, no auto-fold), matching the existing Pin/Unpin unit test contract.
Corner-anchored envelope renders without clipping against the simulated work-area edges in ReelPreview's own canvas.
